🗾 Dataset
	

The IDRCell100k dataset is a comprehensive collection of biological images, meticulously curated to represent a broad spectrum of microscopy techniques and channel configurations. It comprises 79 different experiments, utilizing 7 types of microscopy techniques, with images featuring multi channels counts. Each experiment contributes 1300 images, culminating in a total of 104,093 multiplexed images, each resized to 224x224 pixels. This dataset, unique in its diversity… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nicoboou/IDRCell100k.
